description: Tree indexes preserve annotated words and expose ordered navigation; parser loading and annotation are opaque dependencies.
state: Annotated words, cached ordered kids, external annotator Result and environment.
cost: Index O(n); sub O(v*(1+|cut|)+v log v), O(v) output/stack and O(1) extra guard storage; no visited allocation in production.
forward: Construct kids[j] as increasing i with head[i]=j+1 and 1<=head[i]<=n. head maps invalid heads to None; root is first head-zero. sub returns sorted reachable indices avoiding cut descendants; dominates follows at most n+1 head steps. text preserves requested repetitions; content uses six UPOS values. parse/of_forms/parse_cased normalize forms and lemmas after optional repair. cap uppercases the first Unicode scalar; name_like consults dictionary and suffix exclusions.

Subtree traversal suppresses enqueueing its start: constructor-built child lists contain each vertex at most once, so any reachable cycle contains the start. The result is sorted reachable vertices after non-start cuts, including cyclic heads.
inverse: Behavior complement is U minus the declared deterministic relation on scoped observations.
Reverse reconstruction retains all compatible inputs; finite fibers do not uniquely recover text.
checks: functional_graph_sub_matches_visited_reachability: 86078 head/root/cut cases, n=1..4, with independent visited-set oracle.
limitations: Synthetic annotated fixtures; parser loading, dictionary semantics, repair and I/O remain external.
Partial syntax only; no general accuracy or runtime safety claim.
